t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are six gnomes and the gnomes correspond to a colour basket (red or yellow)- e.g. the blue brown and yellow gnomes correspond to the yellow basket. If one basket is doing well and then the points start to swap, switch to the other colour basket

vb_textbox.text: There are eight gnomes of different colours (pink, brown, purple, red, yellow, orange, blue, and green). The gnomes will each pick a specific coloured basket (red or yellow). The pink, brown, purple, and red gnomes pick the red basket. The yellow, orange, blue, and green gnomes pick the yellow basket. The colour of the baskets go through phases of having lots of mushrooms or fewer mushrooms. So if picking the red basket is getting a lot of mushrooms, keep doing that. If the numbers of mushrooms decrease significantly, switch to the other basket colour (by picking the corresponding gnome colour). For example, if the red basketwas doing well (5+ mushrooms), and then it is only getting 3 mushrooms, try switching to the yellow basket.
